## Approval checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/release/prepare-market-entry.mjs --package <name>` was reviewed.
- [ ] The current upstream contribution schema was checked manually.
- [ ] npm package, GitHub Release, and tag contain the same version and tarballs.
- [ ] Repository topics will be changed manually by an authorized maintainer.
- [ ] No credentials, private topology, logs, or user data are present.
- [ ] An authorized maintainer explicitly approves opening the external PR.

This template does not authorize automation to call GitHub or the market.
